steps.code:
# Build CSV content from notes
import re

# Extract date from title and habit values from content
rows = []
for note in all_notes_content:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not match:
        continue
    date = match.group(1)
    
    # Parse content lines
    content_lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    habit_values = {}
    for line in content_lines[1:]:
        if line.strip():
            parts = line.split(': ')
            if len(parts) == 2:
                habit_values[parts[0].strip()] = parts[1].strip()
    
    # Build row values in habit_names order
    values = [habit_values.get(habit, 'no') for habit in habit_names]
    rows.append([date] + values)

# Sort rows descending by date (date is first element)
rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[0], reverse=True)

# Build CSV string
header = ['date'] + habit_names
csv_lines = [','.join(header)]
for row in rows:
    csv_lines.append(','.join(row))
csv_content = '\n'.join(csv_lines)

print("CSV content preview:")
print(csv_content[:500])
print("...")
print("Total lines:", len(csv_lines))
